senses.gloss: adv. (apocop. of קליל), ק׳ ק׳ little by little, slowly.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 51a:2">Erub. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>כי מסגי ק׳ ק׳</he> when he walks step by step, opp. <he>רהט</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 153b:10">Sabb. 153ᵇ</cite> <he>דוקא רץ אבל ק׳ ק׳ לא</he> only when one runs (is it permitted), but when one walks leisurely is it not?
